messages.subject: Generator availability
messages.body:
Hi,

Do you have a 20kVA diesel generator available for rent? I'd need it for about a week, sometime this month if possible.

Ville Junttila

messages.subject: Invoice query - floor saw rental
messages.body:
Hello,

I received the invoice for my diamond floor saw rental and there are a couple of items I'm not sure about. Could someone walk me through the breakdown?

Thanks,
Mikko Rantanen

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query - floor saw rental
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

Thanks for letting us know. I'll pull up your invoice and come back to you with the details.

Best regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query - floor saw rental
messages.body:
Hi Outi,

Actually I also have a question about another invoice, the one for the compact track loader. There's a charge on it that I don't recognise. Would you mind checking that one as well?

Mikko

messages.subject: Cancellation refund - RB-20265176
messages.body:
We had to cancel booking RB-20265176 for the 140L concrete mixer this morning. The site programme changed overnight and we didn't need the unit after all. We would like a full refund of the 150 EUR.

Please advise when we can expect the credit.

Oulujoen Betonityoe Oy

messages.subject: Delivery to Rovaniemi - diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi there,

I'm planning to book a diamond floor saw and wondering what the delivery options are for Rovaniemi. Is delivery to a residential address possible and what would it cost?

Laura Keranen

messages.subject: Deposit deduction
messages.body:
Hello,

We have been notified that part of our deposit will be withheld due to the condition of the returned equipment. Our understanding has always been that deposits are fully refundable regardless of the equipment's condition on return. We have been renting from you for years and this has never been raised before.

We expect the full deposit to be returned.

Nostopalvelu Karjula Oy

messages.subject: Re: Deposit deduction
messages.body:
Hi,

Thank you for writing. I have noted your concern and will review the return inspection record for your rental. I will be in touch once I have the details.

Jussi Karna
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Deposit deduction
messages.body:
Jussi,

Unrelated to the deposit, but could you also check our site cabin invoice? One of the line items doesn't look right.

Nostopalvelu Karjula Oy

messages.subject: Compact track loader - repeat booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Can I get the compact track loader again, same as my last booking? Let me know what dates you have open.

Ville

messages.subject: Excavator return - Kempele
messages.body:
Hello,

I need to sort out the return of the 13-tonne excavator. Can it be collected from my site in Kempele, and what times work for pickup?

Minna Ojanpera

messages.subject: Re: Excavator return - Kempele
messages.body:
Hi Minna,

Got your message. I'll check the transport schedule for Kempele pickups and let you know the available slots.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Excavator return - Kempele
messages.body:
Hi Petri,

Quick question on a separate thing. I've got an invoice with a charge for site fencing, per 50m run, and I'm not sure how the amount has been worked out. Could you clarify?

Thanks,
Minna
